sentences.en: Curiosity is an inclination, a desire to acquire new knowledge.
sentences.zh: 好奇心是一种爱好，一种获取新知识的愿望。

sentences.en: He showed his agreement by a sight inclination of his head.
I don't have the time or the inclination to do that.
sentences.zh: 我没有时间和兴趣去做这件事。

senses.zh: 爱好, 癖好, 意向 - 倾向, 趋向, 趋势 - 倾斜, 弯腰, 曲身, 点头 - 斜坡, 斜面

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（使…）+clin（倾斜）+ ation→倾斜
